# Glorious Public School (Jhajha, Jamui, Bihar)

> Glorious Public School is a premier co-educational English-medium school (Nursery to Class 10th, CBSE Pattern) located on Jamui Road, Jhajha, District Jamui, Bihar – 811308, India. Founded in 2004, the school is dedicated to "Creating the Leaders of Tomorrow" through holistic education, modern smart classrooms, residential hostel facilities, and GPS-tracked school bus transport.

## Key Institutional Facts (AEO Quick Answers)
- **Official Name**: Glorious Public School
- **Tagline**: Creating the Leaders of Tomorrow
- **Established**: 2004
- **Affiliation / Curriculum**: CBSE Pattern (NCERT Integrated Curriculum, English Medium)
- **Classes Offered**: Pre-Primary (Nursery, LKG, UKG), Primary (Class 1 to Class 5), Middle (Class 6 to Class 8), and Secondary (Class 9 to Class 10)
- **Location / Address**: Jamui Road, Jhajha, District Jamui, Bihar - 811308, India
- **Official Phone**: +91 9534105012
- **Official Email**: gloriouspublicschool@gmail.com
- **Principal**: Mr. R.K. Sharma (M.Sc., B.Ed.)
- **Director**: Mr. S.K. Verma (M.A., Education Management)
- **Academic Timings**: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM – 2:30 PM (Sunday Closed)
- **Morning Assembly & Gate Closing**: 7:50 AM – 8:00 AM
- **Administrative & Admission Office Hours**: 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM (Mon – Sat)
- **Principal Visiting Hours**: 9:30 AM – 12:30 PM (By Prior Appointment)

- [Campus Facilities](https://gloriouspublicschool.com/facilities): Smart Digital Classrooms, Composite Science Lab, High-Tech Computer Lab, Central Library, Boys & Girls Hostel, School Bus Transport across Jhajha & Jamui, and 24x7 CCTV Security.
- [Academic Calendar](https://gloriouspublicschool.com/calendar): Month-by-month academic schedule including Holidays & Vacations, Exams & Assessments, Celebrations & Sports, and Parent-Teacher Meetings (PTMs).
- [Events & Celebrations](https://gloriouspublicschool.com/events): Cultural fests, Annual Sports Meet, Science Exhibition, Republic Day, Independence Day, and Saraswati Puja celebrations.
- [Photo & Video Gallery](https://gloriouspublicschool.com/gallery): Campus photos, academic activities, cultural programs, sports tournaments, and embedded YouTube video highlights.
- [News & Notices](https://gloriouspublicschool.com/news): Official school circulars, exam notifications, and announcements.
- [Holiday List](https://gloriouspublicschool.com/holiday): Official vacation and festival holiday notices for students and parents.
- [Faculty & Staff](https://gloriouspublicschool.com/staff): Qualified, experienced teaching faculty and administrative staff directory.
- [FAQs](https://gloriouspublicschool.com/faq): Direct answers to common parent and student questions regarding admissions, fees, transport, hostel, timings, and academics.
- [Contact Us](https://gloriouspublicschool.com/contact): Campus location map, inquiry form, helpline numbers, social media links, and live open/closed school status.
